field.name: vt_military_agi_full_exemption_threshold
field.comment: Vermont military retirement income exemption, Act 71 of 2025 (32 V.S.A. 5830e(d)): all federally taxable military retirement and survivor benefit income is exempt when federal AGI is $125,000 or less, any filing status (Schedule IN-112 Part I line 13; 2025 IN-112 instructions p. 3-4).

field.name: vt_military_agi_no_exemption_threshold
field.comment: Vermont military retirement income exemption phases out between federal AGI $125,000 and $175,000: the exempt share is (175,000 - AGI) / 50,000 rounded to two decimals, and nothing is exempt at $175,000 or more (IN-112 Military Retirement Income Exemption Worksheet Section II; 32 V.S.A. 5830e(d)).

field.name: vt_military_retirement_exemption
field.comment: VT military retirement income exemption (computed per return in VT_Tax): the pay times the Section II share, 1.00 at or below $125,000 of federal AGI (#1330).

field.name: vt_military_retirement_taxable
field.comment: VT taxable military retirement after exemption (computed)
